decisions.reason: The building digital twin service fits the firm's strategy and market trends, but it has only been mentioned on the website without visible promotion, which leaves a moderate risk of withdrawal.
The authentication and delegation service overlaps with the identity service and could be folded into it, but it costs little to maintain and supports integration projects.
The open GIS application development framework is core to the firm's open, extensible component strategy and underpins its customer projects.
The identity service was actively promoted for seamless GeoIT integration and directly supports the goal of integrating with enterprise systems.
The newly launched consulting workshop has its own page, needs little investment, and draws in customers for the firm's consulting and project business.
